topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I wake up to the distant rumble of machinery, a sound that seems to vibrate through my bones. It’s early, but I know what’s happening. My neighbor is starting the work on that fence. The sky is pale, the air crisp, but there's a weight in the air, a tension. I hesitate at the window, fingers gripping the sill. From here, I can see the first pieces of metal being driven into the ground, the beginning of a dividing line. I can’t shake the unease. This isn’t just a fence; it’s a statement, a barrier. I wonder if things will ever be the same between us, if the space between our homes will feel as open as it once did.
